[USER] User inquired about the benefits of tea tree oil for treating acne and skin conditions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tea tree oil has antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties that may help treat acne and other skin conditions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Proper application method for tea tree oil includes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Dilute tea tree oil with a carrier oil (coconut oil, jojoba oil, or almond oil) in a 1:10 ratio.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Cleanse the skin with a gentle, non-comedogenic cleanser.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Apply the diluted mixture with a cotton swab or cotton ball to the affected area and massage gently.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Allow the mixture to dry on the skin and do not rinse off immediately. Repeat twice a day.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Note: Conduct a patch test before use to check for irritation.  
[USER] User asked if tea tree oil can be used to treat scars or dark spots on the skin.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, tea tree oil may help reduce the appearance of scars and dark spots due to its properties.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It should be diluted with a carrier oil in a 1:10 ratio before application.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Apply the mixture to the affected area and leave it on for a few hours before washing it off.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Results may vary, and consulting a dermatologist is recommended.  
[USER] User inquired about applying tea tree oil directly to the face without diluting it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is not recommended to apply tea tree oil directly to the face as it can cause irritation and other adverse effects.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Always dilute tea tree oil with a carrier oil in a 1:10 ratio and conduct a patch test.
